blocks.text: (Satellite image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Champi, which is still outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) may affect the country as early as Monday, Oct. 19, the state weather bureau said on Friday. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Daniel James Villamil said in a 5 p.m. weather advisory that the trough or extension, of Champi may trigger rains in parts of the Visayas and Mindanao. The weather disturbance is forecast to enter the PAR on Tuesday, Oct. 20. “Posible itong pumasok ng ating Philippine area of responsibility by Tuesday, pero as […]...
